name: Workspace settings lens rhythm
goal: Open workspace settings and prove the General tab keeps full-size controls and one left edge at every matrix variant: the name field is a whole pointer target, and after a wheel over the body (a no-op at 1x, where the tab fits; at 200% text it brings the summary card into view) the At a glance card is a whole target sharing the body's left edge (HIG 7b). The 1x name-to-summary gap and the field's s4 inset are asserted from the production geometry in workspace_settings_overlay.rs, because ux-bench can only measure a pair that is co-visible and the two never are at 200% on an 800 px body.
